description: This file defines interfaces and a class related to broadcast channel subscriptions within the Orleans framework. It includes the IBroadcastChannelSubscription interface, the IOnBroadcastChannelSubscribed interface, and the internal class BroadcastChannelSubscription that implements the subscription logic.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscription
classes.description: An internal class implementing IBroadcastChannelSubscription, managing subscription details and attachment logic.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches handlers for published messages and errors to the broadcast channel stream.
